aboutPage.storyTitle: Founded on passion. Driven by purpose.
aboutPage.storyText1: Nexora was founded in 2015 with a simple idea — to create spaces that are beautiful, functional and sustainable.
aboutPage.storyText2: Since then, we have partnered with clients around the world to bring their ideas to life through thoughtful design and innovative solutions.
aboutPage.teamTitle: Meet the people behind our success.
